newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cathay Pacific falls after 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Cathay Pacific falls after 1996 results.

text.p: Shares of Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd eased in Thursday morning trade amid a general weakness in the stock market and despite the fact the company's 1996 results fell within analysts' expectations.
The stock was down HK$0.05 at HK$11.95 on volume of 859,000 shares. Brokers said investors were seen switching out of the stock after the 1996 earnings report released on Wednesday.

"Investors who found the earnings not surprising would square their position and switch to its parent Swire Pacific which is due to announce results very soon," a sales manager at a regional brokerage said.
The Hong Kong flag carrier posted a net profit of HK$3.81 billion, lifted by an HK$541 million exceptional gain from the sale of most of its stake in Hong Kong Dragon Airlines Ltd.

"Despite the fact that the company had done quite well in 1996, we are not going to revise our earnings estimates in view of its relatively dull prospects in the long run," said an analyst at a local brokerage.

"We maintain our estimate at about a 24 percent rise in 1997 net profit to HK$4.72 billion, but a 21.5 percent fall in 1998 earnings to HK$3.71 billion," said Sean Li, associate director at Amsteel Securities.
